text:
maria.docs: FYI — opened PR #842 to canonicalize anchor links in the rate-limits & tiers docs. Site build showed several 404s when navigating from the dashboard panel. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

alex: thanks, I skimmed. mostly mechanical but one anchor uses camelCase, we prefer kebab-case urls.

sasha: can we also add a redirect for the old anchors in _redirects? Cloud CDN still has links out in the wild.

maria.docs: good call. plan: (1) normalize anchors to kebab-case, (2) update SDK snippet header example, (3) add Netlify _redirects for the old anchors, (4) update dashboard panel link id. pushing a patch shortly.

kevin: the SDK snippet in rate-limits.md uses the old X-API-KEY header example. I can drop a replacement if you want — v2 uses Authorization: Bearer <token>.

maria.docs: please do, kevin. I will also add a short note about quota-tier semantics (burst vs sustained) since some wording was ambiguous.

kevin: snippet suggestion pasted:```js
// JS SDK example: prefer Authorization header now
const res = await fetch("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`,
    "Content-Type": "application/json"
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: "rwd-small", prompt: "hello" })
});
```

priya: quick QA note — the analytics panel link in docs points to panel id 124 which was renamed to 214. That was why the dashboard link 404'd in the new build.

maria.docs: updated panel id in the PR and added the _redirects entry for the old anchors. Also clarified the tier table: added rows for "burst credits" vs "sustained throughput".

alex: I left one tiny nit in the markdown (missing backticks around route param). Other than that LGTM.

sasha: CI passed for the docs site preview (netlify). I still want the redirects tested — can you paste a sample redirect rule you added?

maria.docs: added these to _redirects:```
#/old-rate-limits#burst  /docs/rate-limits#burst-credits  301
#/old-rate-limits#tiers  /docs/rate-limits#quota-tiers  301
```

maria.docs: also updated the SDK snippets page with kevin's header change and a short callout about per-route quotas.

priya: re-ran the preview link — panel link resolved, anchors work, and snippet displays correctly in mobile.

alex: approving the PR now.

sasha: me too. i'll queue the merge after 10m to let analytics smoke tests run.

deploybot: site deploy queued for branch docs/canonical-anchors. build started at 2026-03-23T14:12:05Z.

deploybot: site deploy succeeded — preview available at https://deploy-preview-842--docs.redwood.ai

maria.docs: thanks all! I'll follow up with a quick changelog blurb and a short note to support about the redirect so they can update any saved links. :tada:
